name: omniscope-web
displayName: OmniScope OSINT Global Tactical Grid (Web Edition)
description: Zero-key open-source geospatial intelligence, 147-model numerical weather consensus, global surveillance webcams, seismic activity, and severe storm tracking via Cloudflare Edge.
author: FinnyTech

tools.name: omniscope_weather_consensus
tools.description: Calculate live meteorological multi-model consensus across 147 certified models (DWD ICON, ECMWF IFS, NOAA GFS, etc.) for any global coordinate.

tools.name: omniscope_storm_intercept
tools.description: Fetch real-time convective storm telemetry, NWS tornado/severe thunderstorm warnings, and radar-indicated rotation cells.

tools.name: omniscope_search_webcams
tools.description: Search global surveillance, highway, alpine, and scenic public webcams by location, country, or keyword.

tools.name: omniscope_seismic_monitor
tools.description: Query real-time global tectonic activity from USGS feeds, including magnitude, epicenter, depth, and tsunami alert flags.

tools.name: omniscope_space_weather
tools.description: Retrieve current geomagnetic storm activity, planetary Kp-index, solar flux, and aurora visibility forecasts from NOAA SWPC.

tools.name: omniscope_generate_sitrep
tools.description: Synthesize a comprehensive, structured tactical Situation Report (SITREP) combining weather, seismic, surveillance, and threat metrics for a specified location.
